Maria G.: FYI customer cust-922 reported an unexpected burst charge on APAC invoice INV-6021. Looks like the same 12,500 tokens were billed twice across two nodepools. Link to invoice: https://invoices.redwood/inv_6021.pdf :eyes:
Samir C.: Can you paste the line items? Is this across different regions or same region with two nodepools?
Maria G.: Same region (apac) but two nodepools. Condensed export: ```line_item_id,desc,nodepool,committed,used,burst,amount
B2001,Reserved commit - apac-pool-a,apac-pool-a,80000,80000,0,4000.00
B2002,Burst - apac-pool-a,apac-pool-a,80000,12500,12500,625.00
B2003,Burst - apac-pool-b,apac-pool-b,0,12500,12500,625.00
B2004,Reserved commit - apac-pool-b,apac-pool-b,30000,29000,0,1500.00
``` Charging both pools for the same 12.5k burst -> ~625 USD duplicated.
billing-bot: Metering-proxy event: 2026-04-11T11:07:02Z - tag re-assignment during live-failover for cust-922. Event id mp-7782. Logs: /meters/mp-7782.log
Priya R.: Looks like metering-proxy re-tagged requests when the failover occurred. Runtime routed traffic to pool-b but we didn't retain origin_tag so billing saw two separate billable tags.
Samir C.: Policy: if duplication caused by internal tag re-assignment on our side, we issue a full credit for the duplicated burst portion and add 5% goodwill on the next invoice. Need (1) evidence of duplicate token ids in same UTC minute window, (2) match of both line items to same customer id, and (3) confirmation the metering-proxy changed tags.
Maria G.: I've attached the token export and metering logs to case BILL-2026-222. Token export path: /exports/cust-922/20260411_token_ids.csv. Placed INV-6021 on provisional hold until 2026-04-18.
Alex (Finance): Finance pre-approves provisional journal entry up to $700. Use JE 5-210-BILL and memo "dup burst credit cust-922". Final amount subject to verification.
Priya R.: Infra follow-up: we'll add an ingress origin_tag that persists through failover so re-tagging won't generate new billable line items. Filing INFRA-903. ETA for fix 2 weeks.
Samir C.: Next steps: devops to confirm dedupe via token hashes, billing to request adjusted invoice from metering vendor, finance to prepare JE draft. Target close: 2026-04-17.
billing-bot: Token dedupe job scheduled. ETA 3h. Output: /exports/cust-922/dedupe_report_20260411.json
Maria G.: Thanks all — I'll update the customer thread with provisional credit note once dedupe confirms duplication. :thumbsup:
